• Governed access to product geometry across internal teams and external partners
• No derivative-file distribution of product geometry
• Preserved configuration control and IP containment
• Enterprise-scale access to product definition across suppliers, factories, and service

Vertex operates as infrastructure, not a collaboration application.

Proven at scale:
• 350,000 users in service ecosystems

• 60,000+ PLM changes processed per day

Vertex provides governed access to the system of record.
